map.把一次性初始投资、逐年净现金流与项目期末残值统一折现到当前时点。净现值大于 0: It discounts a one-off initial investment, yearly net cash flows and the terminal residual value to the present. A project creates value when NPV is above 0 and IRR exceeds the discount rate; where the two diverge (NPV positive but IRR low), NPV governs. Static payback uses undiscounted cash flow, dynamic payback takes the point where cumulative discounted value first covers the investment, interpolated linearly within the year. Everything runs locally in the browser and data is never uploaded.

map.NPV 为负还能做吗？: Can a project proceed with a negative NPV?
map.NPV<0 说明折现后不创造价值，原则上不做；若战略协同或融资杠杆能改善则可另议: NPV below 0 means no value is created after discounting, so in principle do not proceed; strategic synergies or financing leverage that change the picture may warrant a second look.
map.IRR 越高越好？: Is a higher IRR always better?
map.在规模相当、风险相当时越高越好，但要警惕高 IRR 来自短期回款或过小基数，需结: Yes, at comparable scale and risk, but watch for a high IRR coming from fast early recovery or a tiny base; read it together with NPV.
